name: typescript-module-boilerplate
description: Boilerplate for TypeScript modules using modern tooling.

scripts.check: bun --bun oxfmt --check . && bun --bun oxlint . && tsc --noEmit && ts-unused check tsconfig.json
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --target=node --format=esm --outdir ./dist --entry-naming [name].js --sourcemap && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun run check && bun run test
